The '''Cyborg/Droid Interface''' was produced by [[Neuro-Saav Technologies/Legends|Neuro-Saav Technologies]]. It allowed [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborgs]] to connect directly to [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and share information.
